digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, completion verifier, close-path attestation guard
propositions: An AC retagged [operator-attested] with code-verifiable evidence (repo paths/test symbols) bypassed plan-review guards and reached the completion verifier, which trusted the tag by design (ADR-0043), allowing close to succeed without proof.

Evidence-kind criterion ran but did not fire on the tagged repo-provable AC due to LLM judgment miss; det_measurement_provenance detected missing provenance lines but was wired as ADVISORY (p6_ac_quality), not blocking.

A deterministic pre-LLM, fail-closed close-path guard is required: det_attestation_launder.py detects laundering (repo paths/test symbols in AC text with [operator-attested] tag) and blocks before verifier runs, coaching untag/split/provenance fixes.

Mixed-evidence ACs (repo citation for orientation + external outcome proof) require split: test-shaped citations always fire; other repo paths fire only when preceded by evidence-marker words, and Gerrit/commit references never fire per ADR-0043 contract.
